title: Fix Interactive Disposition Resize
description: Resizing interactive dispositions only drags them. Fix resize handles, flow-layout resize rendering, chrome positioning with display:contents, and group resize dx/dy.
summary:
Fixed projektetage resize handles that appeared to only drag or do nothing.

Root cause: reveal.js nests slide sections; the inner interactive section has offsetHeight 0, so clientToSectionFraction and measureDispositionBoundsInSection saw zero height and resize deltas were always 0.

Fix: slideCoordinateRoot + slideLayoutBounds walk to the parent stack with real layout size; dispositionPlacementContainer, clientToSectionFraction, measurement, flowPixelOffsetToSectionRect, and sectionVisualScale use them. Wired interactiveDispositionContentScale on flow resizes for uniform zoom without text reflow. Tests: nested zero-height fraction mapping + flow SE resize regression. 51 renderer tests pass; verified on :6050 title slide.
